inventedEvidence.evidence: 'From what you have checked, this needs an appliance engineer' - the customer had not checked anything yet

rationale: The assistant used a generic burning-smell stop-use template on the first message and escalated to an engineer. The case was a belt-driven brushbar jam with a snapped belt, where the smell happened only at the moment it stopped, and a safe unplugged check and belt replacement was the right path. It asked no questions and gave no guidance. It also wrongly implied the customer had already done checks. The unplug advice was safe, but the escalation was unnecessary and the customer was left with no useful progress.
